import sqlite3
import csv

# Get all post IDs with ViewCount between 100-150
conn = sqlite3.connect("context/db/posts.db")
cursor = conn.cursor()
cursor.execute("SELECT Id FROM posts WHERE ViewCount BETWEEN 100 AND 150")
post_ids = set(row[0] for row in cursor.fetchall())
conn.close()
print(f"Number of posts: {len(post_ids)}")

# Read comments and filter by PostId
max_score = -1
best_comment = None
with open("context/csv/comments.csv", "r") as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        post_id = int(row["PostId"])
        if post_id in post_ids:
            score = int(row["Score"])
            if score > max_score:
                max_score = score
                best_comment = row

print(f"Highest score: {max_score}")
print(f"Comment ID: {best_comment['Id']}")
print(f"Post ID: {best_comment['PostId']}")

print(f"UserDisplayName: {best_comment['UserDisplayName']}")
